_comment: sim-couple-shortcut-settle-dt-v1 -- dock-align the assembly cart/robot spawn to the configured couple dock, so the coupled train faces the outbound lane heading. The ONE dock source is the active outbound tow lane: its explicit `couple_dock`, else DERIVED from its `start` + `start_cart_yaw` (the side-bay lane below carries only those, SOUTH). The derived south dock equals the hand-authored towstaging3 couple_dock (-3.875, 15.77, -90deg). Without this the cart spawns at the legacy EAST scenario yaw, the couple seats an east-facing train, and the SOUTH side-bay lane is never acquired (coldwin25e).
_start_at_couple_shortcut: A start_at=couple bench dock-aligns AUTOMATICALLY from this lane (no flag needed): couple_start_poses/staged_scenario resolve the dock from start+start_cart_yaw. apply_start_state then holds the train at the seat through a sim-time settle and verifies the cart rests at the dock heading (START_STATE_UNSUPPORTED / START_STATE_SETTLE_MISMATCH).
_cold_run: For a COLD run (no start_at), set `couple_dock_align: true` to spawn the assembly cart+robot at the same resolved dock, with the same rest+heading verify (verify_dock_seat). Default off => byte-identical; a legacy EAST lane whose derived dock equals the scenario spawn is a no-op. GPU note: the cart spawn moves to the dock position; confirm the cold collect still reaches the load pose at that dock on the first bounded GPU run.
_settle_tuning_optional: All sim-time; defaults match the legacy 30-tick floor at 1/60. hold_during_settle (default true) pins base+cart at the seat through the settle so the portal_floor_box flat-floor box cannot tip the train.

tow_lanes.name: outbound_dock_to_side_bay
tow_lanes._or_explicit_dock: couple_dock may be set explicitly instead of deriving from start+start_cart_yaw
